statements.status_notes: pgproto3/v2 is a transitive dependency via pgx/v4. The standalone pgproto3/v2 module is archived (EOL July 2025) with no fix available. The vulnerability is resolved in pgx/v5's internal pgproto3, but migrating pgx/v4 to pgx/v5 is a major version change requiring upstream action.
